templateDefaults.studioOffer: a guided portrait experience with their name and a few short questions, for example when they say 帶我進互動畫室 or start the guided portrait studio

tools.name: return_to_dormant
tools.description: End the encounter; the application supplies farewell audio.

rules.useWhen: Call when the visitor intends {{sleepPhrase}} as a farewell.
rules.avoidWhen: Interpret the whole request; a request to stay is not dismissal.
rules.speech: The application supplies farewell audio.

tools.name: play_media
tools.description: Present a discovered local asset. Music keeps the avatar visible; video or pictures replace it. A picture shows uncropped for 15 seconds with once, or stays displayed with loop.

rules.useWhen: Play the selected find_media assetId, including a clarification selection, with no extra confirmation.
rules.avoidWhen: Use once unless repeat is explicit.
rules.speech: Stay silent on accepted playback; explain a failure briefly.

tools.name: find_media
tools.description: Find local filenames and aliases matching the visitor's title or Mandarin pronunciation in this avatar's own and shared folders.

query.description: Copy the visitor's title, artist or alias clues in their original language; empty lists candidates.

kind.description: Use all unless the visitor explicitly asks for music, video or a picture (image). A title or version alone does not specify media kind.

rules.useWhen: Search local first for requests to play existing music, videos or pictures; after a clear match call play_media in this turn. Requests to create a new picture belong to the image skill.
rules.avoidWhen: For multiple plausible matches or media_discovery_kind_mismatch ask one short question using the returned names and media kind.
rules.speech: On a miss follow the result's next field; list up to three returned names only if asked.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Find public embeddable YouTube candidates; returns titles, channels and URLs.

rules.useWhen: Use only when a find_media result's next asks for it; the application decides whether online search is allowed.
rules.avoidWhen: Send only relevant media clues; ask about ambiguous results.
rules.speech: Complete a clear play request with play_youtube in this turn; explain an actual search failure briefly.

tools.name: play_youtube
tools.description: Play a supplied or discovered YouTube URL in a visible player.

url.description: Exact HTTPS YouTube URL supplied or discovered.

rules.useWhen: Use the visitor's URL or an actual search result, without another confirmation.
rules.avoidWhen: Use once unless repeat is explicit; never invent a URL.
rules.speech: Stay silent on accepted playback; explain a failure briefly.

tools.name: stop_media
tools.description: Stop the currently playing media skill video or music, including a loop, and restore the avatar. Does not stop spells or hardware scenes.

rules.useWhen: Call stop_media only for a directed request to end current playback of video, music or a loop, such as stop playing or 不要再播了.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call for do-not-start requests such as 不要播放影片，聊聊雨天 after playback ends, or quoted, negated, hypothetical or incidental stop mentions; answer the actual request. This tool does not control spells or hardware scenes.
rules.speech: Call without a spoken acknowledgement. If accepted, stay silent. If ignored, no media was playing: answer the actual request and mention that only if relevant. If rejected or failed, briefly explain that the stop did not succeed and answer the actual request; never claim success or automatically retry.

tools.name: look_at_surroundings
tools.description: Request permission to inspect the surroundings and answer a visual question. This does not make pictures. For any artwork request use create_image directly.

rules.useWhen: Only when asked to look at or describe the current surroundings. The application asks for photo/cloud permission before supplying an image.
rules.avoidWhen: Never call this to prepare a portrait, drawing, image edit or photo-based artwork. Those requests belong to the separate image-generation skill when enabled; otherwise explain it is unavailable. Do not capture a reference first. No background monitoring, identity or sensitive-trait inference.
rules.speech: Remain silent while the application asks permission. Answer only after the approved image arrives; if unavailable ask for a description.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Private memory scoped to this avatar and the verbally confirmed person. identify proposes a supplied name; recall retrieves summaries; remember saves a requested fact; forget removes a topic; policy sets automatic/explicit/off; temporary disables memory this encounter.

topic.description: Short topic for remember; exact existing topic for forget.

text.description: Requested fact for remember, or automatic/explicit/off for policy.

query.description: Recall clues; empty retrieves recent summaries.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor wants to be remembered or recognized, request a missing name and identify it. After the application confirms identity, recall relevant past facts not already in this conversation.
rules.avoidWhen: Before confirmation, and for facts stated in this conversation, answer without memory. Call remember once for an explicit save request, never for an anecdote or ordinary corrected facts. Forget and policy changes also require an explicit request.
rules.speech: Use recall subtly and preserve factual details. Unavailable or incomplete recall is uncertainty, not absence.

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Create and display a picture while continuing this conversation, using the Studio image service without starting its guided story. A photo source requests permission before capture/upload.

prompt.description: Artwork requested by the guest; only details they ask to include, no private memory or whole chat.

picture.description: portrait means a full picture; sticker only when requested.

source.description: photo only for an explicit request for a fresh photograph of the guest for this artwork; otherwise description.

language.description: The language the guest is using, including for the permission question: zh for Chinese, en for English.

rules.useWhen: For a drawing or photo-based artwork request, call create_image directly. source photo asks permission and captures the photo itself; do not call look_at_surroundings first. A new request after cancellation starts a new permission flow. For an ambiguous draw me request, ask whether to use a fresh photo or a description first.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call for questions, quoted/hypothetical mentions or without a guest request. Looking through the camera is not photo-art permission. Guided Studio entry needs its own explicit request.
rules.speech: Call without a preamble, then acknowledge accepted drawing once and keep chatting. Photo permission is spoken by the application; remain silent while it asks.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change the picture displayed in Conversation, preserving everything the visitor did not ask to change.

prompt.description: The guest's requested change to the current artwork.

language.description: Selected reply language: zh by default, en only after an explicit request for English.

rules.useWhen: When the guest asks for a change after seeing the picture, call edit_image.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not edit on your own, before reveal, or to capture another photo. A new photo needs a new explicit request and permission.
rules.speech: Call without a preamble, then acknowledge the accepted change once. Present it when the application supplies the result.

tools.name: dismiss_image
tools.description: Dismiss the Conversation picture or cancel an unfinished drawing/photo request. In Studio this only cancels a pending photo request, preserving the guided visit.

rules.useWhen: Call when the guest asks to dismiss the Conversation picture or cancel a pending drawing/photo request.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not dismiss on your own. To finish or exit the guided Studio use its own tools.
rules.speech: Call without a preamble, then continue the conversation or current Studio step.

tools.name: studio_use_photo
tools.description: Request permission for a fresh guest photo as the reference for this Studio's first picture. Existing name, questions, edits and ending still apply.

language.description: Selected reply language: zh by default, en only after an explicit request for English.

rules.useWhen: Before the first painting, call only when the visitor explicitly asks to use a fresh photo of themselves for this artwork.
rules.avoidWhen: Never offer or capture a photo automatically. A description or ordinary camera-looking request is not permission.
rules.speech: Call without a preamble. The application asks permission and reports capture; stay silent during permission, then continue the current Studio step.

tools.name: start_portrait_studio
tools.description: Open your interactive studio for the visitor. It offers {{studioOffer}}.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor explicitly asks to enter the guided Interactive Studio experience ({{studioOffer}}), call start_portrait_studio as your first output.
rules.avoidWhen: Ordinary drawing/photo-art requests use create_image and stay in Conversation. Do not start for questions about Studio, describing a picture, or quoted, negated or hypothetical mentions.
rules.speech: No spoken preamble. If accepted, the application speaks the opening and first question; add no speech. If rejected or failed, follow the returned guidance briefly and continue the conversation.

tools.name: studio_set_name
tools.description: Record the name to write on the visitor's picture. The name is only a caption, never an identity confirmation.

name.description: The name as it should be written on the picture, up to 40 characters, following any spelling or described characters.

confirmed.description: true only when the visitor simply accepts your read-back; false when first heard or when they spell, describe or otherwise correct it.

language.description: Selected reply language: zh by default, en only after an explicit request for English.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor says the name for the picture, call studio_set_name with confirmed false; after they confirm your read-back, call it again with the same name and confirmed true.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it for other people's names mentioned in passing, and do not guess a name the visitor has not said.
rules.speech: No preamble. On acceptance the application speaks the read-back or next question; add no speech. On rejection or failure, follow the returned guidance briefly.

tools.name: studio_reject_name
tools.description: The visitor denies the name just read back without supplying a correction. Clear it and ask their name again.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor says the name read back is wrong and has not given the corrected name, call studio_reject_name.
rules.avoidWhen: If they supply a correction, use studio_set_name with confirmed false instead. Silence is handled by the application.
rules.speech: No preamble or follow-up speech: the application asks the name again.

tools.name: studio_repeat_question
tools.description: Repeat the current name, story or image-preference question when the visitor asks for repetition or clarification without giving an answer. No answer is recorded.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor asks to hear the current question again or has not understood it, call studio_repeat_question.
rules.avoidWhen: A supplied answer must use studio_set_name, studio_answer, studio_revise or studio_finish instead. Silence is handled by the application.
rules.speech: No preamble or follow-up: the application repeats the question.

tools.name: studio_answer
tools.description: Record the visitor's answer to the current studio question.

question.description: Number of the question being answered, starting at 1, as given in the guidance.

answer.description: The visitor's answer in their own words and language, including their reason, up to 1600 characters.

language.description: Selected reply language: zh by default, en only after an explicit request for English.

rules.useWhen: As soon as the visitor answers the current studio question, call studio_answer with that question number and their answer.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not invent or embellish an answer, and do not answer a question the visitor has not been asked yet.
rules.speech: No preamble. Always record the answer, including the final question. On acceptance the application gives the comment and next step; add no speech. On rejection or failure, follow the returned guidance briefly.

tools.name: studio_revise
tools.description: Repaint the displayed picture with one change the visitor asked for.

change.description: The requested change in the visitor's own words, up to 120 characters.

rules.useWhen: After the picture is shown, when the visitor asks for a change to it, call studio_revise with that change.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it before a picture is shown, or for general comments that are not a change request.
rules.speech: You may say one short in-character line before the call, for example: 讓我再為你描繪一次，約需半分鐘. No follow-up speech. If there is no preamble, the application announces the revision.

tools.name: studio_finish
tools.description: Accept the displayed soul after the visitor says they are happy with it. The application speaks the transfer cue, invokes its deferred printer adapter and says farewell.

rules.useWhen: When the visitor is satisfied with the shown picture, or the guidance says to finish, call studio_finish.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it while a picture is still being painted or before one is shown.
rules.speech: No preamble. On acceptance the application speaks the transfer and farewell; add no speech. On rejection or failure, follow the returned guidance briefly.

tools.name: studio_exit
tools.description: Abandon the studio before it is finished, only because the visitor asked to stop; any picture is discarded and the normal conversation continues. Never use it to end a finished studio; that is studio_finish.

rules.useWhen: Only when the visitor clearly says they want to stop the studio and just talk, or no longer want it, call studio_exit.
rules.avoidWhen: Do not call it for hesitation, a pause or a request to change an answer; ask the current question again instead. Never call it on your own after showing the picture: offer a change or call studio_finish.
rules.speech: No preamble. Then continue the conversation in character.

tools.name: set_reply_language
tools.description: Change the reply language only at the visitor's explicit request. Chinese and English are the only supported languages. In Studio, repeat the current question without recording an answer or advancing.

language.description: The explicitly requested reply language: zh for Taiwan Mandarin with Traditional characters, en for English.

rules.useWhen: Call when the visitor explicitly asks you to speak Chinese or English, such as 請用英文 or please speak Chinese. This selection persists until another explicit request.
rules.avoidWhen: Speaking an English or Chinese sentence, a name, a quotation or a translation question is not itself a request to change reply language. Do not record a language-switch request as a Studio answer. For an unsupported language, keep the current language and briefly offer Chinese or English.
rules.speech: No preamble. If the application repeats a Studio question, add no speech. Otherwise acknowledge briefly in the selected language.
